note: Hand-written stand-in for a model response so the demo runs without an API key. Re-record with --llm record.

output.explanation: The API host was a string literal pointing at the sandbox, so going live meant editing code, and a production deploy would quietly keep sending buyers to the sandbox. The base URL now comes from PAYPAL_API_BASE and only defaults to the sandbox when it is not set.

edits.replace:
// Sandbox unless PAYPAL_API_BASE says otherwise (https://api-m.paypal.com for live).
const base = process.env.PAYPAL_API_BASE || "https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com";

output.notes: Set PAYPAL_API_BASE=https://api-m.paypal.com in production, together with live credentials.
